R-Innorichment

Innorichment flat enrichment sheets offer a precise quantity of 100% virgin kraft sheets that arrive irradiated and pre-inserted into each pre-bedded Innocage®.

Key Advantages:

  • Keeps rodents active and helps reduce aggression.
  • Helps regulate body temperature (thermoregulation).
  • The flat zigzag pattern allows for more complex foraging and nesting activity.
  • Pre-inserted option with each pre-bedded Innocage®.
